title: [OCT18] Reminder: If you arrive on time...
message:
... it means you're already late.

 

Hello everyone, we are on a new schedule and now is the perfect time to readjust
your arrival time.  

 

For example: Morning life that starts at 9 AM - If you arrive to church at 9 AM
you're already late. It will take you 10 minutes to getting the building and
your life group will end up starting at 9:15AM. 

 

The same goes for the 10 AM live group and the 11 AM gathering. While there is
always room to extend things a little bit, let's try to keep our rhythm as much
as possible; at the end of October will do a reassess to see if we need to do
any adjustments.

 

Note:

1- Please bring your workbooks - some have not yet been updated to version 1.2.

2- For guests joining life group; they need to register before Thurs. We are
currently fully packed and will need a week in advance to accommodate new life
groups. Once they register, I will find a time for their new life group. Note:
whoever invited them needs to be part of the life group as well.

4- Gathering starts at 11 AM. 

5- Worship leaders and teams. It would be great if someone can step in for us to
have at least twice a month live worship.

 

Blessings,

Jorge
author: Jorge Lin
